# 用你的代码替换 ___

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.children = []

    def add_child(self, child):
        self.children.append(child)

class Tree:
    def __init__(self, root=None):
        self.root = root
        
    def postorder_traversal(self, node, traversal=[]):
        if node is None:
            return traversal
        # 首先访问子节点
        for child in node.children:  
            self.postorder_traversal(child, traversal)
        # 然后访问节点本身
        traversal.append(node.data)
        return traversal


A = TreeNode('A')
B = TreeNode('B')
B1 = TreeNode('B1')
B2 = TreeNode('B2')
B1_1 = TreeNode('B1_1')


A.add_child(B)
B.add_child(B1)
B.add_child(B2)
B1.add_child(B1_1)


general_tree = Tree(A)
print(general_tree.postorder_traversal(general_tree.root))
